subject: q10jy reset at probe first contact: no defect found in relay/K02 path; q10jz adds kern.n2vctrace breadcrumbs (0310 regenerated)
body: Audit of everything that reached the vcodec nodes in q10jy (vcodecd: open minor0/INFO/close; n2vcd_probe after 45 s: open minor1 -> INFO (server_present 0) -> close every 1 s) found NO defect: locks are initialised (STARTUP entries present in sweet_touch.o, same pattern as camdev), no lock recursion (order n2vr_lock -> n2vc_mtx only), proc_find/proc_rele balanced, INFO hw half = same path vcodecd ran fine, no msleep/deadline reached with server absent, frames <=0x460. Host replay test_probe_replay (t_relay.c, ASan/UBSan/O2/TSan: exact sequence x90 + the server-present HELLO path) passes. Root cause therefore NOT verified; crash coincides with the probe's first open but could be elsewhere. Change (IK+K02 files edited, IK owner please note): each of the first kern.n2vctrace (default 64, sysctl RW) entries into either node prints 'NORD2 VCT o1 p43' / 'NORD2 VCT i1 p43 0x40405601' before the handler and 'NORD2 VCT =err' after. n2vcd_probe.c now sets kern.n2vctrace=64 before its first open (__APPLE__ only; needs an iOS rebuild by whoever owns ios/build.sh). Tests: IK 5879/5879, P031X 589024/589024, K02 588919/588919 x2, make_series OK. Building q10jz now (recipe = build_q10jy.sh, 0310 regenerated). NOTE: ios/test/run_tests.sh currently fails linking vcodecd (n2a32_call undefined from daemon/n2vcd_selftest.c) - not mine, in-flight emu edit?
